conviction_note: Findings genuinely offset: a mechanical GAAP-EPS beat from the Q3 bitcoin fair-value gain and the chance of a refinancing or Corsicana update stand against a +16% one-day sector rebound into the print, a peer's mining-revenue miss and a sector-wide 'lease catalyst drought' call; p_up 50 on a 13% absolute move gives 0, which is the honest result.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus EPS -$0.32 / revenue $163.96M (14 analysts, FXEmpire https://www.fxempire.com/stocks/riot/earnings); Benzinga -$0.29 / $172.7M, TipRanks -$0.27, EarningsWhispers -$0.33 / $161.16M (as relayed by search). EPS sources agree to within $0.06, revenue spans $161-173M. No company guidance (Q2 release gave none: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001167419/000110465926093406/riot-20260810xex99d1.htm). The stock trades on AI/HPC lease and financing news and bitcoin, not on GAAP EPS.
positioning_check: Short interest ~48.2M shares, ~14.8% of float, 2.8 days to cover at the 2026-09-30 settlement (Curved Trading / AltIndex citing FINRA, https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/riot/short-interest/ ; https://altindex.com/ticker/riot/short-interest), down from 51.1M / 3.6 days on 2026-09-15. Moderately crowded, not extreme. Skew +19.2 vol points (25d put minus call), downside paid; put/call OI 0.93; event-implied move 15.05%. Tape: 20d -26.9%, -51.7% from 52w high, but +16% intraday on 2026-11-03 after -7.6% on 2026-11-02 (247wallst, Benzinga).

findings.finding: Bitcoin rose 42.7% in Q3 2026 (from $58,527 at 30 June per Riot's own Q2 release to roughly $83.5k at 30 Sep), so Riot's fair-value accounting on its BTC holdings (11,380 BTC at 30 June, reduced by sales since) should give a gain on the order of $150-290M, enough to turn GAAP EPS positive against a consensus of about -$0.30; the headline will read as a large EPS beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 GAAP EPS -$0.68 missed -$0.27 on the fair-value loss and the stock rose +4.33% (on the AI lab lease news), so this name has not traded on the fair-value EPS line.
findings.why_not_priced: The BTC price is public, but the visible consensus (-$0.27 to -$0.33) has not modelled the fair-value gain; if it had, consensus would be positive. The gain is below operating income and has no path to guidance, so the stock should look through it, which is why it is small.
findings.independence: Riot's Q2 release gives the 30-June BTC price $58,527 and holdings of 11,380 BTC: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001167419/000110465926093406/riot-20260810xex99d1.htm. Riot sold 3,778 BTC in Q1 and more in Q2 (https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/riot-platforms-sells-3778-btc-q1-2026-gpb4vo), so Q3 holdings and the gain may be smaller.

findings.finding: The $573M Morgan Stanley delayed-draw bridge that funds the 191 MW frontier AI lab build matures on 31 Dec 2026, and the investment-grade backstop the CFO said would refinance it 'in the coming months' had not been announced by 3 Nov. The ~$180M AMD term loan also had no closing announced, although it was expected before 30 Sep. The print is the natural place for an update. The money funds a signed 20-year lease worth $9.1B of contract revenue, so a refinancing is more likely to read as positive than a further delay is to read as negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Shares fell about 8% from 30 Sep to 7 Oct, with press coverage centred on the bridge maturity (CrowdFund Insider, TIKR). Peer Hut 8 closed $7.5B of investment-grade project financing and was among the leaders of the 3 Nov rebound (+16%).
findings.why_not_priced: The maturity is well known and the stock is down 31% since 30 Sep, so the risk itself is in the price. What is not priced is whether the print carries a definitive refinancing. If the market expected one, the skew would not be +19 vol points to the downside.
findings.independence: The $573M facility and its Dec-31 maturity appear in Riot's 8-K of 10 Aug 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001167419/000110465926093406/riot-20260810x8k.htm). The 2026-09-21 Coinbase prepayment 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1167419/000110465926111003/riot-20260921x8k.htm) shows liquidity being used to pay off other debt. Hut 8's IG financing is a peer precedent: https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/03/hut-8-surges-16-ahead-of-earnings-as-bitcoin-miners-rebound-riot-platforms-surges-14-mara-holdings-jumps-9/

findings.finding: The Corsicana 1 GW site (about 756 MW of critical IT) is still under a non-binding LOI with a single tenant, disclosed on 10 Aug, which management valued at more than $1B of annual rent at full deployment. No definitive lease has been announced. Conversion at this print is possible but undocumented: it would be a very large positive, while no update is a mild negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Rockdale 191 MW AI lab lease, announced with Q2 results on 10 Aug, bought +4.33% close to close, and other coverage cited intraday gains of about 24%.
findings.why_not_priced: A lease is a binary that the stock cannot price ahead of the event. KBW cut its target 35 to 20 on 2 Nov and warned of a 'lease catalyst drought' through early 2027, so the street is leaning towards no lease.
findings.independence: KBW's 'lease catalyst drought' call points the other way: https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/03/cipher-digital-soars-11-as-ai-data-center-stocks-rebound-after-price-target-selloff-iren-jumps-10-terawulf-surges-9. Search found no definitive Corsicana lease.

findings.finding: Peer Cipher Digital reported Q3 on 2 Nov with revenue of $26.7M against $37.5M consensus, on shrinking bitcoin-mining revenue. KBW then cut targets across the group, including Riot from $35 to $20. This is a read-through to Riot's mining-heavy revenue line (Q2: $113.7M of $174.2M) and to sentiment on AI lease timing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Riot fell 7.57% on 2 Nov on the KBW cut and AI-lease demand concerns, then rose 16% on 3 Nov. Q2 2026 revenue beat by 12% on engineering and data-center fit-out revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the 2 Nov drop reflected it, and the 3 Nov rebound took it back. It is a weak proxy because Cipher is exiting mining while Riot is still mining at scale, and Riot's Q3 average BTC price was similar to Q2's.
findings.independence: Same article and day as the KBW cut. Sector context: https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/03/hut-8-surges-16-ahead-of-earnings-as-bitcoin-miners-rebound-riot-platforms-surges-14-mara-holdings-jumps-9/

findings.finding: RIOT rose about 16% intraday on 3 Nov, the session before the print, to about $13.8 (the sealed spot is $13.845), on a sector-wide rebound in miners and AI data-center stocks rather than on any Riot-specific news. That follows -7.6% on 2 Nov and -27% over 20 days. The print starts from a one-day squeeze high, against put skew of +19 vol points.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior case on file of a double-digit run into the print. Across 7 prints the reactions were mixed, 3 up and 4 down, with a median absolute move of 6.94%.
findings.why_not_priced: The skew already pays for downside, so this is partly priced. Short interest is 14.8% of float with 2.8 days to cover, so a further squeeze is possible and the finding is kept small.
findings.independence: 247wallst puts RIOT at +14% to $13.55 on the sector rebound: https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/03/hut-8-surges-16-ahead-of-earnings-as-bitcoin-miners-rebound-riot-platforms-surges-14-mara-holdings-jumps-9/ ; FXEmpire shows $13.77 at +16.28% at 13:41 ET: https://www.fxempire.com/stocks/riot/earnings

findings.finding: Riot has reported every print in the baseline after the close, but it scheduled the Q3 call for 08:00 ET on 4 Nov (bmo), announced 20 Oct. The release does not state the time of the results. The cadence change has no stated reason.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no history: all 7 prior prints were amc.
findings.why_not_priced: It is uninterpretable on its own. Hut 8 also reports on 4 Nov, and some outlets say Riot's results come after the 3 Nov close, which would fall in the same scored window.

outside_window.finding: The $573M bridge matures on 31 Dec 2026. If the print does not refinance it, the deadline itself lands after the window.
AMD Phase 3 (10 MW) is due in November 2026 and Phase 4 (15 MW) in May 2027. First rent on the AI lab's first 96 MW is due in December 2027.

baseline_tension: Mixed: the put skew (+19) and the -27% 20-day run-up say downside is feared, while the +16% session into the print cuts the other way. My findings are balanced and neither confirm nor fight the skew.
lessons_applied: Rule 2: the fair-value EPS beat is a below-operating-income one-off with no path to guidance, cut from +0.5 to +0.3
Rule 4: asked what the bridge buys (a signed $9.1B, 20-year AI lab lease), so the financing finding stays positive at +0.5 rather than turning negative
Rule 5: Corsicana conversion is an inference with no document, cut from +0.5 to +0.3; the Cipher peer read-through is a weak proxy (Cipher is exiting mining), cut from -0.5 to -0.3
Rule 7: the negative run-up/positioning finding agrees with the skew and faces 14.8% short interest, cut from -1.0 to -0.8
Baseline history check: the reaction history is confirmed earnings-based (monthly updates stopped after Dec 2025), so it is used as is
Net: impact_sum stays 0.0 and p_up stays 50
